cause: The Global Agent protocol did not make the receipt-to-branch-evidence path sufficiently direct, while the receipt reader rejected a visible project overview containing more than four candidate runs.

evidence.ref: CE4 Global Agent turn ended max_steps_exceeded after repeated schema and coefficient inspections

impact: A user can complete a typed multi-branch workflow yet receive no answer from the advisory Agent despite the required stored evidence being present.
lesson: Bounded evidence tools and their protocol must provide one explicit low-step path from visible candidate runs to a completed workflow receipt, branch evidence, and a direct answer.
